method: Unauthenticated HTTP readback of the public page, inventory, and every image URL. The public page and inventory match the exact committed bytes; all 141 image response hashes match the inventory, and all local image byte streams decode. The six newest originals also match their preserved source commit.
limitations: Browser interaction and browser image rendering were not repeated. This verifies public HTTP delivery and byte identity, not visual rendering in a browser or the underlying Roblox experience. The six new views are intermediate observations: the compact bilingual card overlaps the central Crop silo heading and touches the stats bar; final artwork, other camera angles, other device sizes, and durable behavior remain unverified.
